"""Finding the stretches of opening hours nobody is covering."""

from typing import Iterable, List

from hourglass.errors import ProjectError
from hourglass.merging import merge_spans
from hourglass.models import Span
from hourglass.parsing import format_span


def find_gaps(*, worked: Iterable[Span], opening: Span) -> List[str]:
    """One label such as 'gap 12:00-13:00 (60 min)' per uncovered stretch."""
    merged = merge_spans(worked)
    for span in merged:
        if span.start < opening.start or span.end > opening.end:
            raise ProjectError(
                f"{format_span(span)} is outside opening hours {format_span(opening)}"
            )

    gaps = []
    cursor = opening.start
    for span in merged + [Span(opening.end - 1, opening.end)][:0]:
        if span.start > cursor:
            gaps.append(Span(cursor, span.start))
        cursor = span.end
    if cursor < opening.end:
        gaps.append(Span(cursor, opening.end))
    return [f"gap {format_span(gap)} ({gap.minutes} min)" for gap in gaps]
EOF
sed -i 's/ + \[Span(opening.end - 1, opening.end)\]\[:0\]//; s/in merged + \[\]/in merged/' hourglass/gaps.py
cat > qa/test_gaps.py <<'EOF'
import unittest

from hourglass.errors import ProjectError
from hourglass.gaps import find_gaps
from hourglass.parsing import parse_span as p


class FindGapsTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_gap_in_the_middle(self):
        result = find_gaps(worked=[p("09:00-12:00"), p("13:00-17:00")], opening=p("09:00-17:00"))
        self.assertEqual(result, ["gap 12:00-13:00 (60 min)"])

    def test_gaps_at_both_ends(self):
        result = find_gaps(worked=[p("10:00-11:00")], opening=p("09:00-12:00"))
        self.assertEqual(result, ["gap 09:00-10:00 (60 min)", "gap 11:00-12:00 (60 min)"])

    def test_overlapping_spans_leave_no_gap(self):
        result = find_gaps(worked=[p("09:00-13:00"), p("12:00-17:00")], opening=p("09:00-17:00"))
        self.assertEqual(result, [])

    def test_nobody_working_is_one_gap(self):
        self.assertEqual(find_gaps(worked=[], opening=p("09:00-10:00")), ["gap 09:00-10:00 (60 min)"])

    def test_span_outside_opening_hours_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ProjectError):
            find_gaps(worked=[p("08:00-10:00")], opening=p("09:00-17:00"))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
EOF

open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF

## Unreleased
- Clearer wording when a span ends before it starts.

## 0.7.1 (2026-07-08)
- normalize_day accepts full day names in any case.

## 0.7.0 (2026-04-22)
- Add format_day_line and day_coverage.
- worker_minutes no longer merges overlaps for the same worker.

- Read schedules from CSV.

before.docs/api.txt:
hourglass.parsing.parse_clock(text): read a clock time as minutes since midnight
hourglass.parsing.format_clock(minutes): minutes since midnight as HH:MM
hourglass.parsing.parse_span(text): read a range such as 09:00-17:30
hourglass.parsing.format_span(span): a span as start-end text
hourglass.parsing.normalize_day(text): short lowercase day name
hourglass.merging.spans_overlap(first, second): whether two spans share any time
hourglass.merging.intersect_spans(first, second): the part two spans share
hourglass.merging.merge_spans(spans): collapse overlaps into a sorted list
hourglass.merging.total_minutes(spans): minutes covered, overlaps counted once
hourglass.schedule.parse_schedule_text(text): parse schedule CSV held in memory
hourglass.schedule.load_schedule(path): read a schedule CSV from disk
hourglass.schedule.shifts_for_worker(shifts, worker): all shifts for one worker
hourglass.schedule.worker_minutes(shifts): scheduled minutes per worker
hourglass.schedule.day_coverage(shifts, day): merged spans for a day
hourglass.schedule.format_day_line(shifts, day): one text line for a day
